summaries.Good news: Real human progress is happening: a CRISPR therapy slashed cholesterol by 52% in a first human trial, and communities continue stepping up with remarkable kindness—from a pub owner creating a stunning holiday display to lift spirits during tough times, to neighbors replacing a teen entrepreneur's stolen equipment.
summaries.Ideas: AI is fundamentally reshaping how we work and think: from the hidden human intelligence behind design that AI can't replace, to how personal AI agents are changing brand loyalty and social dynamics, raising important questions about the future of work, particularly for underrepresented groups.
summaries.Technology: Breakthrough innovations are making products lighter, smarter, and more sustainable: from ETH Zurich's collision-resistant drones and 3D-printed film cameras, to BYD's retractable steering wheel and ultra-fast 30,000-rpm motors that could revolutionize EVs, alongside bio-computing and color-shifting health patches.
summaries.Design: Design thinking is expanding into unexpected domains—from ZHA's sweeping theatre facade responding to landscape, to Atelier Manferdini's electrical substation transformed into expressive art, to candleholders reimagined as cultural conversation, showing how thoughtful design elevates everyday infrastructure and objects.

items.title: The hidden human intelligence of design

Often overlooked are the years of education and experience that shape what you
items.line: The hidden human intelligence embedded in years of design education and experience cannot be automated away, challenging the assumption that AI can simply replicate design outcomes.

items.title: Can AI Generate Good Designs from Raw User Data?

items.title: To win the AI search wars, stop chasing the answers and start shaping the questions
